options.content: Source: the session store's `concern_transitions` table, read from the derived copy `serve --observe-snapshot` rewrites every 5 s (docs/developers/observability.md). The copy is read-only and never read by the controller. Panel-to-table map: `tools/observability/dashboards/README.md`. Causes are the closed `policy.Cause` wire values; `previous` and `held (game hours)` read `unknown` when the controller restarted or the clock went back.

panels.description: Source: concern_transitions for the selected concern, newest first: each change of its winning cause, what it was before and how long that stood in game time (2,500 ticks to the hour).

targets.queryText: SELECT datetime(wall_ms/1000, 'unixepoch') AS "time (UTC)", tick, verdict, cause, subject, method, CASE WHEN previous_cause IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN previous_cause = '' THEN '(clear)' ELSE previous_cause END AS previous, CASE WHEN held_ticks IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE round(held_ticks / 2500.0, 1) END AS "held (game hours)" FROM concern_transitions WHERE concern = '$concern' ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 500
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT datetime(wall_ms/1000, 'unixepoch') AS "time (UTC)", tick, verdict, cause, subject, method, CASE WHEN previous_cause IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN previous_cause = '' THEN '(clear)' ELSE previous_cause END AS previous, CASE WHEN held_ticks IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE round(held_ticks / 2500.0, 1) END AS "held (game hours)" FROM concern_transitions WHERE concern = '$concern' ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Concern timeline

panels.description: Source: concern_transitions, the newest row per concern with its change count (the table keeps the newest 8192 rows). Pick one in the Concern variable above.

targets.queryText: SELECT t.concern, t.verdict, t.cause, t.subject, t.method, t.tick, datetime(t.wall_ms/1000, 'unixepoch') AS "changed (UTC)", m.changes FROM concern_transitions t JOIN (SELECT concern, max(sequence) AS s, count(*) AS changes FROM concern_transitions GROUP BY concern) m ON t.sequence = m.s ORDER BY t.wall_ms DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT t.concern, t.verdict, t.cause, t.subject, t.method, t.tick, datetime(t.wall_ms/1000, 'unixepoch') AS "changed (UTC)", m.changes FROM concern_transitions t JOIN (SELECT concern, max(sequence) AS s, count(*) AS changes FROM concern_transitions GROUP BY concern) m ON t.sequence = m.s ORDER BY t.wall_ms DESC

panels.title: Concerns by latest change

panels.description: Source: concern_transitions (one row per change of a concern's winning cause; the table keeps the newest 8192 rows). Counted by concern and cause.

targets.queryText: SELECT concern, verdict, cause, count(*) AS transitions, max(tick) AS last_tick FROM concern_transitions GROUP BY concern, verdict, cause ORDER BY transitions DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT concern, verdict, cause, count(*) AS transitions, max(tick) AS last_tick FROM concern_transitions GROUP BY concern, verdict, cause ORDER BY transitions DESC
